system.description: You can spend a Force Point as a Swift Action to bend light around you, veiling yourself in shadows. Until the end of the encounter, whenever you move and end your movement at least 3 squares away from your starting position, you gain Concealment from all targets until the beginning of your next turn.

prerequisite.text: a member of The Disciples of Twilight
